description: This file defines the MediaStoreDataClient class for the AWS SDK, specifically for interacting with the AWS Elemental MediaStore Data Plane service. It declares methods for object operations such as deleteObject, describeObject, getObject, listItems, and putObject, including their asynchronous variants.

classes.name: MediaStoreDataClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Elemental MediaStore Data Plane service, extending the base AWS SDK client.

methods.name: deleteObjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an object from MediaStore.

methods.name: describeObjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes an object in MediaStore.

methods.name: getObjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an object from MediaStore.

methods.name: putObjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads an object to MediaStore.
